---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who does it help, and how?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like to see. Be as specific as you can.

## Alignment with Product Principles

OSSmith is built around specific [product principles](../../README.md#product-principles) (teach before solving, human stays in control, quality over quantity, etc.). Briefly explain how this proposal supports them.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why you prefer this one.

## Additional Context

Mockups, links, prior art in other tools, or anything else that helps explain the request.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and the [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md) to make sure this isn't already planned
- [ ] I've explained how this aligns with OSSmith's product principles
- [ ] I'm willing to help implement this (optional, but appreciated!)
